english: No place better for brunch than the Sleeping Dragon Inn. Whew... I'm stuffed.
french: Il n'y a pas meilleur endroit pour un brunch que l'auberge du Dragon qui dort. Pfiou.... Je suis repu.
russian: Нет лучше места для позднего завтрака, чем «Спящий дракон»... Ух, объелся.
bulgarian: No place better for brunch than the Sleeping Dragon Inn. Whew... I'm stuffed.

english: Salutations!
french: Salutations !
russian: Приветствую!
bulgarian: Salutations!

english: There's nothing like a hot bath in the cold season.
french: Rien ne vaut un bain chaud pendant la saison froide.
russian: Горячая ванна в холодный сезон не сравнится ни с чем!
bulgarian: There's nothing like a hot bath in the cold season.

english: The bathhouse is much preferable, thank you!
french: Les bains sont bien préférables, crois-moi !
russian: Купальня сильно предпочтительнее!
bulgarian: The bathhouse is much preferable, thank you!

english: It's been such a blessing that Juniper has revitalized the Bathhouse. Some days, I used to work a full shift in the mines and then wash in the freezing river.
french: C'est une vraie bénédiction que Juniper ait relancé les bains. Certains jours, après une journée à la mine, je devais me laver dans l'eau glacée de la rivière.
russian: То, что Джунипер оживила купальню, — просто благословение. Бывали дни, когда я весь день отрабатывал смену в шахтах, а потом мылся в ледяной реке.
bulgarian: It's been such a blessing that Juniper has revitalized the Bathhouse. Some days, I used to work a full shift in the mines and then wash in the freezing river.

english: It might be nice to close out the weekend by enjoying the sea breeze... perhaps I'll take a walk to the Beach.
french: Ça pourrait être agréable de clore le week-end en profitant de la brise marine... Je vais peut-être aller me promener jusqu'à la plage.
russian: Будет неплохо закончить выходные, наслаждаясь морским воздухом... Думаю, пройдусь-ка я по пляжу.
bulgarian: It might be nice to close out the weekend by enjoying the sea breeze... perhaps I'll take a walk to the Beach.

english: I think it's about time for me to turn in, [Ari]. Whew, what a day!
french: Je crois que c'est bientôt l'heure pour moi d'aller me coucher, [Ari]. Pfiou, quelle journée !
russian: Думаю, пришло время заканчивать на сегодня, [Ari]. Фух, ну и денёк!
bulgarian: I think it's about time for me to turn in, [Ari]. Whew, what a day!

english: There's a type of Aldarian schooner that utilizes something similar.
french: Eh bien, il existe une goélette aldarienne qui a un peu la même.
russian: Похоже на существующую альдарийскую шхуну.
bulgarian: There's a type of Aldarian schooner that utilizes something similar.

english: Landen's got some big ideas about Terithia's boat. The sail construction he's described...
french: Landen a de grandes idées pour le bateau de Terithia. La mâture qu'il a évoquée...
russian: У Ландена много идей для лодки Теризии. Он описывал дизайн конструкции паруса...
bulgarian: Landen's got some big ideas about Terithia's boat. The sail construction he's described...

english: I'm always impressed by your boundless energy, [Ari].
french: Ton énergie sans limites m'impressionne toujours, [Ari].
russian: Меня всегда поражает твоя безграничная энергия, [Ari].
bulgarian: I'm always impressed by your boundless energy, [Ari].

english: Looking forward to catching up with Landen... there's always something fun to talk about.
french: J'ai hâte de voir Landen pour prendre des nouvelles... Nous avons toujours des sujets de discussion amusants.
russian: Жду не дождусь возможности пообщаться с Ланденом... Нам всегда есть о чём поговорить.
bulgarian: Looking forward to catching up with Landen... there's always something fun to talk about.

english: Baron Wiscar has many strong points, but landscaping isn't one of them.
french: Le baron Wiscar a beaucoup de points forts, mais l'art paysager n'en fait pas partie.
russian: У барона Вискара много талантов, но ландшафтный дизайн не один из них.
bulgarian: Baron Wiscar has many strong points, but landscaping isn't one of them.

english: I'm really glad that Adeline appointed Celine to take care of the manor gardens.
french: Je suis vraiment content qu'Adeline ait nommé Céline à l'entretien des jardins du manoir.
russian: Я так рад, что Аделина назначила Селин ухаживать за садами особняка.
bulgarian: I'm really glad that Adeline appointed Celine to take care of the manor gardens.

english: [Ari], good morning! If you've got something new, just bring it by the Museum any time!
french: [Ari], bonjour ! Si tu récupères quelque chose de nouveau, apporte-le quand tu veux au musée !
russian: [Ari], доброе утро! Если найдёшь что-то новое, просто приноси в музей в любое время!
bulgarian: [Ari], good morning! If you've got something new, just bring it by the Museum any time!

english: Eiland often invites me to dinner... I always bring a healthy appetite, ha ha!
french: Eiland m'invite souvent à dîner... Et j'arrive toujours avec un bel appétit, ha ha !
russian: Эйланд часто приглашает меня на ужин... Я всегда приношу гостинцем хороший аппетит, ха-ха!
bulgarian: Eiland often invites me to dinner... I always bring a healthy appetite, ha ha!

english: The displays are looking mighty fine these days. The Museum is really filling up!
french: Les collections sont vraiment belles, maintenant. Le musée se remplit !
russian: В последнее время экспонаты у нас что надо! Музей пополняется отличными экземплярами!
bulgarian: The displays are looking mighty fine these days. The Museum is really filling up!

english: Here to donate something? The Museum welcomes your contributions!
french: Tu es là pour faire un don ? Tes contributions au musée sont les bienvenues !
russian: Ты здесь, чтобы что-нибудь пожертвовать? Музей всегда рад твоему вкладу!
bulgarian: Here to donate something? The Museum welcomes your contributions!

english: But he... doesn't always focus on the present moment.
french: Mais il n'est pas toujours très... attentif au moment présent.
russian: Но он... не всегда внимателен к настоящему.
bulgarian: But he... doesn't always focus on the present moment.

english: Case in point, I noticed today that he accidentally filed away some pottery fragments into my desk's snack drawer.
french: J'en ai un bel exemple : aujourd'hui, je me suis rendu compte qu'il avait rangé des fragments de poterie dans le tiroir de bureau où je stocke mes encas.
russian: Вот пример: сегодня я заметил, что он случайно убрал черепки от керамики в ящик моего стола, где я держу закуски.
bulgarian: Case in point, I noticed today that he accidentally filed away some pottery fragments into my desk's snack drawer.

english: Don't be surprised if you catch him lost in a daydream. That's just how he is.
french: Ne t'étonne pas si tu le trouves en train de rêvasser. C'est son tempérament.
russian: Не удивляйся, если застанешь его витающим в облаках. Он просто такой человек.
bulgarian: Don't be surprised if you catch him lost in a daydream. That's just how he is.

english: Eiland has always had a tremendous interest in history.
french: Eiland a toujours porté un immense intérêt à l'histoire.
russian: Эйланд всегда питал огромный интерес к истории.
bulgarian: Eiland has always had a tremendous interest in history.

english: It's quite endearing, even if I spend most of the meeting bringing him back to reality.
french: C'est très mignon, même si je passe ensuite l'essentiel de notre rencontre à le ramener à la réalité.
russian: Это даже умиляет, в каком-то смысле. Хоть мне и приходится тратить большую часть встречи на то, чтобы вернуть его с небес на землю.
bulgarian: It's quite endearing, even if I spend most of the meeting bringing him back to reality.

english: Eiland always gets carried away after hearing my proposals.
french: Eiland s'emballe toujours quand je lui fais des propositions.
russian: Эйланд постоянно раздувает мои предложения до абсурда.
bulgarian: Eiland always gets carried away after hearing my proposals.

english: Lord Eiland's a kind one... he knows Landen and I catch up on rainy days so he'll be watching the front desk at the Museum.
french: Messire Eiland est gentil... Il sait que Landen et moi, on se retrouve les jours où il pleut, alors il vient gérer l'accueil du musée.
russian: Лорд Эйланд — добрый человек... Он знает, что в дождливые дни встречаюсь с Ланденом, и присматривает за ресепшеном музея вместо меня.
bulgarian: Lord Eiland's a kind one... he knows Landen and I catch up on rainy days so he'll be watching the front desk at the Museum.

english: Oh, hello [Ari]! I was just following up on something I read. There's a particular etching I'm searching for...
french: Oh, bonjour [Ari] ! Je cherche des renseignements supplémentaires suite à une de mes lectures. Je suis à la recherche d'une esquisse bien précise...
russian: О, привет, [Ari]! Я исследую кое-что, что прочитал. Я ищу одну конкретную гравюру...
bulgarian: Oh, hello [Ari]! I was just following up on something I read. There's a particular etching I'm searching for...

english: I'll have to do some more reading if I want to follow the thread of this research!
french: Je vais devoir poursuivre mes lectures si je veux remonter le fil de cette recherche !
russian: Придётся прочитать ещё кое-что, если я хочу разобраться!
bulgarian: I'll have to do some more reading if I want to follow the thread of this research!

english: I found the etching I was searching for! But it only raised more questions.
french: J'ai trouvé l'esquisse que je cherchais ! Mais cela n'a fait que soulever d'autres questions.
russian: Я нашёл гравюру, которую искал! Но вопросов стало только больше.
bulgarian: I found the etching I was searching for! But it only raised more questions.

english: [Ari]! It's the big night at the Inn! I had planned to watch the Museum, but Eiland insisted I join the fun!
french: [Ari] ! C'est le grand soir à l'auberge ! J'avais prévu de garder le musée, mais Eiland a insisté pour que je me joigne à la fête !
russian: [Ari]! Сегодня в трактире важный вечер. Я планировал присматривать за музеем, но Эйланд настоял, чтобы я присоединился к веселью!
bulgarian: [Ari]! It's the big night at the Inn! I had planned to watch the Museum, but Eiland insisted I join the fun!

english: I never have to worry that my ramblings about Mistria's history bore you.
french: Je n'ai jamais peur de t'ennuyer quand je radote à propos de Mistria.
russian: Мне никогда не приходится переживать, что мои тирады про историю Мистрии тебе надоедают.
bulgarian: I never have to worry that my ramblings about Mistria's history bore you.

english: You're always an excellent listener, [Ari].
french: Tu as un vrai don pour l'écoute, [Ari].
russian: Ты — прекрасный слушатель, [Ari].
bulgarian: You're always an excellent listener, [Ari].

english: I hear you'll be helping to raise Mistria's $Renown$. How splendid!
french: On m'a dit que tu allais nous aider à accroître la $renommée$ de Mistria !
russian: Слышал, ты будешь помогать поднимать $репутацию$ Мистрии. Это здорово!
bulgarian: I hear you'll be helping to raise Mistria's $Renown$. How splendid!

english: It seems we share a common goal. You can call me Errol, I'm the curator of Mistria's brand new $Museum$.
french: Nous partageons le même objectif, dans ce cas. Tu peux m'appeler, Errol, je suis le conservateur du $musée$ flambant neuf de Mistria.
russian: Пожалуй, у нас общая цель. Меня можно называть Эроллом. Я — куратор нового $музея$ Мистрии.
bulgarian: It seems we share a common goal. You can call me Errol, I'm the curator of Mistria's brand new $Museum$.

english: I hope you'll consider $Donating$ some items. It's a great way to earn $Renown$!
french: J'espère que tu voudras bien faire $don$ de quelques objets. C'est un excellent moyen d'acquérir de la $renommée$ !
russian: Надеюсь, ты согласишься $пожертвовать$ какие-нибудь предметы музею. Это отличный способ поднять $репутацию$!
bulgarian: I hope you'll consider $Donating$ some items. It's a great way to earn $Renown$!

english: You'll even receive $Rewards$ for each $Collection$ you complete.
french: Tu recevras même des $récompenses$ pour chaque $collection$ que tu termineras.
russian: А ещё за каждую собранную $коллекцию$ ты получишь $вознаграждение$!
bulgarian: You'll even receive $Rewards$ for each $Collection$ you complete.

english: Let's support each other's efforts for Mistria, eh? I'll be rooting for you [Ari]!
french: Soutenons-nous mutuellement dans notre engagement envers Mistria, d'accord ? Je t'encouragerai, [Ari] !
russian: Поможем друг другу в нашем общем деле? Во благо Мистрии, а? Болею за тебя, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Let's support each other's efforts for Mistria, eh? I'll be rooting for you [Ari]!

english: Hello, are you the new farmer everyone's been talking about?
french: Bonjour, c'est toi <she>la nouvelle fermière dont tout le monde parle ?</she><he>le nouveau fermier dont tout le monde parle ?</he><they>la personne venue reprendre la ferme et dont tout le monde parle ?</they>
russian:
Приветствую. Должно быть, о тебе все говорят. Ты

новые фермер

новая фермеркановый фермерновое фермер.
bulgarian: Hello, are you the new farmer everyone's been talking about?

english: I typically group artifacts by civilization and era, but perhaps I can get a little more creative.
french: Je regroupe en général les artéfacts selon leur civilisation et leur époque, mais je pourrais peut-être faire preuve d'un peu plus de créativité.
russian: Обычно я группирую артефакты по цивилизациям и эпохам, но, может быть, тут получится придумать что-нибудь поинтереснее.
bulgarian: I typically group artifacts by civilization and era, but perhaps I can get a little more creative.

english: It's quite different from swinging a pickaxe, but both tasks require their own special expertise.
french: Cela n'a rien à voir avec le maniement de la pioche, mais l'une comme l'autre de ces tâches nécessitent un savoir-faire particulier.
russian: Очень сильно отличается от обращения с киркой, но и то и другое требует своего мастерства.
bulgarian: It's quite different from swinging a pickaxe, but both tasks require their own special expertise.

english: Handling ancient artifacts requires a delicate touch.
french: La manipulation des artéfacts anciens est très délicate.
russian: Обращение с артефактами требует деликатности.
bulgarian: Handling ancient artifacts requires a delicate touch.

english: You can always rely on the Sleeping Dragon Inn for a hot meal.
french: Tu peux toujours compter sur l'auberge du Dragon qui dort pour avoir un repas chaud.
russian: На «Спящего дракона» всегда можно положиться, когда нужна горячая пища.
bulgarian: You can always rely on the Sleeping Dragon Inn for a hot meal.

english: I'm looking forward to an idyllic Sunday of cataloguing artifacts at the Museum!
french: J'ai hâte de passer un dimanche de rêve à cataloguer les artéfacts du musée !
russian: Очень жду, когда настанет прекрасное воскресенье. Я планирую провести его, сортируя артефакты в музее!
bulgarian: I'm looking forward to an idyllic Sunday of cataloguing artifacts at the Museum!

english: The Inn is my favorite place to unwind, no matter the season.
french: L'auberge est mon endroit préféré pour me détendre, quelle que soit la saison.
russian: В любое время года трактир — моё любимое место отдыха.
bulgarian: The Inn is my favorite place to unwind, no matter the season.

english: Enterprising, though.
french: Mais ils ne manquent pas d'initiative.
russian: Но надо отдать должное, на месте они не сидят.
bulgarian: Enterprising, though.

english: Whew! Those three little ones are quite a handful.
french: Pfiou ! Ces trois petits-là, ce sont de sacrés galopins.
russian: Фух! С этими тремя проказниками хлопот невпроворот.
bulgarian: Whew! Those three little ones are quite a handful.

english: Excuse me! I have to put away all the files in case young Luc brings another jar of moths.
french: Excuse-moi ! Je dois ranger tous les dossiers, au cas où le jeune Luc apporterait encore son bocal de phalènes.
russian: Прошу меня простить! Нужно убрать все файлы на случай, если юный Люк снова решит принести с собой банку с молью.
bulgarian: Excuse me! I have to put away all the files in case young Luc brings another jar of moths.

english: It looks like Dell's Dragonguard are coming for a visit.
french: On dirait que la Garde des dragons de Dell vient faire une visite.
russian: Судя по всему, скоро нас посетит Драконья стража Делл.
bulgarian: It looks like Dell's Dragonguard are coming for a visit.

english: Oh, ah, and be sure to point out any leaks if you come across them. I thought we had them all, but...
french: Oh, et n'hésite pas à me signaler des fuites si tu en vois. Je croyais que tout était réglé, mais...
russian: О, и, если вдруг заметишь протечки, обязательно сообщи. Я думал, мы все их залатали, но кажется, не все...
bulgarian: Oh, ah, and be sure to point out any leaks if you come across them. I thought we had them all, but...

english: Here to take a look around the Museum, [Ari]? Go right ahead.
french: Tu es là pour jeter un œil au musée, [Ari] ? Vas-y, je t'en prie.
russian: Ты здесь, чтобы осмотреть экспонаты музея, [Ari]? Пожалуйста, проходи.
bulgarian: Here to take a look around the Museum, [Ari]? Go right ahead.

english: Are you listening, children?
french: Vous écoutez, les enfants ?
russian: Ребята, вы слушаете?
bulgarian: Are you listening, children?

english: And so that is how you tell the difference between Caldosian and Aldarian pottery!
french: Voilà, c'est comme ça qu'on peut distinguer les poteries caldosiennes des poteries aldariennes !
russian: И именно так можно различить кальдосийскую керамику и альдарийскую!
bulgarian: And so that is how you tell the difference between Caldosian and Aldarian pottery!

english: Ho ho, take it from me, [Ari], just nod and help yourself to another slice of cake while those three go at it.
french: Ho ho, crois-en mon expérience, [Ari], contente-toi de hocher la tête et de te resservir de gâteau pendant que ces trois-là se disputent.
russian: Хо-хо, я подскажу, [Ari], просто кивай и потихоньку утащи ещё один кусочек торта, пока эти трое так увлечены.
bulgarian: Ho ho, take it from me, [Ari], just nod and help yourself to another slice of cake while those three go at it.

english: Have a look around! And any donations can be left by the ledger there.
french: Fais un tour ! Tous les dons peuvent être déposés à côté du grand livre, là.
russian: Проходи, осмотрись! А если у тебя с собой новые пожертвования, просто оставь их у книги учёта.
bulgarian: Have a look around! And any donations can be left by the ledger there.

english: Who could have imagined this old miner would end up a curator?
french: Qui aurait cru que le vieux mineur que je suis finirait conservateur de musée ?
russian: Кто бы мог подумать, что старый шахтёр станет куратором?
bulgarian: Who could have imagined this old miner would end up a curator?

english: Now where did Landen hide those drinks? I know they're around here somewhere...
french: Allons bon, où Landen a-t-il caché ces boissons ? Je sais qu'elles sont quelque part dans le coin...
russian: Так, где же Ланден спрятал алкоголь? Я знаю, что где-то здесь...
bulgarian: Now where did Landen hide those drinks? I know they're around here somewhere...

english: Those ruins to the west are a marvel! Every day brings new discoveries.
french: Ces ruines, à l'ouest, sont une vraie merveille ! Chaque jour apporte son lot de nouvelles découvertes.
russian: Эти руины на западе просто фантастика! Каждый день — новые находки.
bulgarian: Those ruins to the west are a marvel! Every day brings new discoveries.

english: Sometimes I awaken thinking I must work the Mines again. I suppose it can be challenging for the mind to move on...
french: Il m'arrive parfois de me réveiller en croyant que je dois aller travailler à la mine. L'esprit a du mal à passer à autre chose...
russian: Иногда я просыпаюсь и снова собираюсь на работу в шахты. Полагаю, разуму бывает сложно переключиться...
bulgarian: Sometimes I awaken thinking I must work the Mines again. I suppose it can be challenging for the mind to move on...

english: So much to catalogue! It's like a dream come true. Don't you agree, [Ari]?
french: Il y a tant de choses à inventorier ! C'est comme un rêve devenu réalité. Tu n'es pas d'accord, [Ari] ?
russian: Столько всего предстоит внести в каталог! Это как сон наяву! Не думаешь, [Ari]?
bulgarian: So much to catalogue! It's like a dream come true. Don't you agree, [Ari]?

english: We're still getting the Museum's collection organized! Pardon our dust.
french: Nous sommes encore en train d'organiser les collections du musée ! Désolé pour la poussière.
russian: Мы пока ещё не всю коллекцию в музее рассортировали! Прошу простить обилие пыли.
bulgarian: We're still getting the Museum's collection organized! Pardon our dust.

english: Eiland made an acquisition recently, and I'm attempting to determine whether it's Aldarian or something else entirely.
french: Eiland a récemment fait une acquisition et j'essaie de déterminer s'il s'agit d'un objet aldarien ou de quelque chose de totalement différent.
russian: Недавно Эйланд приобрёл один экспонат, и я пытаюсь определить, альдарийского ли он происхождения или какого-то другого.
bulgarian: Eiland made an acquisition recently, and I'm attempting to determine whether it's Aldarian or something else entirely.

english: I haven't turned up anything new in the Western Ruins lately, but maybe young Eiland has had better luck.
french: Je n'ai rien découvert de nouveau récemment dans les ruines de l'ouest, mais peut-être que le jeune Eiland a eu plus de chance que moi.
russian: Последнее время мне не удаётся найти в Западных руинах ничего нового, но, может быть, Эйланду повезёт больше.
bulgarian: I haven't turned up anything new in the Western Ruins lately, but maybe young Eiland has had better luck.

english: [Ari], please let me know if you stumble across any unusual artifacts. We're always looking to expand the collection!
french: [Ari], surtout, fais-moi savoir si tu tombes un jour sur des artéfacts inhabituels. Nous cherchons en permanence à développer nos collections !
russian: [Ari], пожалуйста, сообщи, если наткнёшься на какой-нибудь новый артефакт. Мы всегда рады пополнить нашу коллекцию!
bulgarian: [Ari], please let me know if you stumble across any unusual artifacts. We're always looking to expand the collection!

english: There's just something about these ruins. I'm not seeing everything, I know it. Does anything catch your eye, [Ari]?
french: Il y a quelque chose, dans ces ruines. Je ne vois pas tout, j'en suis persuadé. Remarques-tu quelque chose de particulier, [Ari] ?
russian: Есть в этих руинах что-то такое, чего я не вижу. Я точно знаю, здесь что-то скрыто. У тебя ни за что глаз не цепляется, [Ari]?
bulgarian: There's just something about these ruins. I'm not seeing everything, I know it. Does anything catch your eye, [Ari]?

english: Yet, somehow... I sense that there is still much waiting to be discovered.
french: Pourtant... Quelque chose me dit qu'il reste encore tant à découvrir.
russian: И всё же... У меня такое чувство, что нам ещё многое предстоит открыть.
bulgarian: Yet, somehow... I sense that there is still much waiting to be discovered.

english: We have learned many new things about these ruins since Seridia arrived to town.
french: Nous avons appris tant de choses sur ces ruines depuis l'arrivée de Seridia en ville.
russian: С тех пор, как у нас поселилась Серидия, мы узнали об этих руинах много нового.
bulgarian: We have learned many new things about these ruins since Seridia arrived to town.

english: Ah, pay me no mind... just the ramblings of a happy old man.
french: Ah, ne fais pas attention à moi... Ce sont seulement les élucubrations d'un vieil homme heureux.
russian: Ах, не обращай на меня внимания... Просто стариковские мысли вслух.
bulgarian: Ah, pay me no mind... just the ramblings of a happy old man.

english: I suppose age is no barrier when it comes to the direction of one's life.
french: L'âge n'est pas une barrière quand il s'agit de donner un sens à son existence.
russian: Полагаю, возраст не преграда, чтобы начать прокладывать новую дорожку в жизни.
bulgarian: I suppose age is no barrier when it comes to the direction of one's life.

english: Who would have thought this old miner would one day become the curator of a museum!
french: Qui aurait cru qu'un vieux mineur comme moi deviendrait un jour conservateur de musée ?
russian: Кто бы представил, что однажды старый шахтёр вроде меня станет куратором музея!
bulgarian: Who would have thought this old miner would one day become the curator of a museum!

english: Poor Olric alone heard out my wild speculations as to their origins!
french: Il n'y avait que le pauvre Olric pour m'écouter me perdre en conjectures improbables sur leur origine !
russian: Только бедняге Ольрику приходилось выслушивать мои рассуждения об их происхождении!
bulgarian: Poor Olric alone heard out my wild speculations as to their origins!

english: Back when I was foreman, I was the only one interested in the artifacts we would stumble across.
french: À l'époque où j'étais contremaître, j'étais le seul à m'intéresser aux artéfacts sur lesquels nous tombions.
russian: Когда я был главным шахтёром, никого, кроме меня, не интересовали артефакты, которые мы иногда находили.
bulgarian: Back when I was foreman, I was the only one interested in the artifacts we would stumble across.

english: The Museum is open to all! Have a good look around, my friend.
french: Le musée est ouvert à tous ! Prends le temps de regarder, mon <he>ami</he><she>amie</she><they>ami·e</they>.
russian: Музей открыт для всех! Рассматривай всё, что захочешь, дружище.
bulgarian: The Museum is open to all! Have a good look around, my friend.

english: This museum relies on the generosity of its patrons, so please don't hesitate if you have something you'd like to donate!
french: Le musée s'appuie sur la générosité de ses mécènes, alors n'hésite pas à faire des dons !
russian: Музей полагается на щедрость своих спонсоров, так что не стесняйся, если друг захочешь пожертововать что-нибудь!
bulgarian: This museum relies on the generosity of its patrons, so please don't hesitate if you have something you'd like to donate!

english: Eiland discovered a fragment of pottery that I'm all too eager to investigate.
french: Eiland a découvert un fragment de poterie que j'ai vraiment hâte d'étudier.
russian: Эйланд нашел фрагмент керамики, который я очень хочу внимательно изучить.
bulgarian: Eiland discovered a fragment of pottery that I'm all too eager to investigate.

english: It's quite beautiful out here. Pulchritudinous, even!
french: C'est magnifique, ici. Plus que splendide, même !
russian: Как же тут прекрасно. Я бы даже сказал, бесподобно!
bulgarian: It's quite beautiful out here. Pulchritudinous, even!

english: Greetings, [Ari]! What brings you out to the Museum on a rainy day like today?
french: Bonjour, [Ari] ! Qu'est-ce qui t'amène au musée par une journée pluvieuse comme aujourd'hui ?
russian: Приветствую, [Ari]! Что привело тебя в музей в этот дождливый день?
bulgarian: Greetings, [Ari]! What brings you out to the Museum on a rainy day like today?

english: The rainy day drink at the Inn is a tradition started by Baron Wiscar! Landen and I keep it going in his stead. Cheers, [Ari]!
french: Le verre des jours de pluie est une tradition initiée par le baron Wiscar ! Landen et moi la perpétuons. Santé, [Ari] !
russian: Традицию выпивать в трактире в дождливые дни начал барон Вискар, а мы с Ланденом её продолжаем вместо него. Твоё здоровье, [Ari]!
bulgarian: The rainy day drink at the Inn is a tradition started by Baron Wiscar! Landen and I keep it going in his stead. Cheers, [Ari]!

english: Back when I worked the Mines, rainy days were always a relief. A cool breeze would blow through the tunnels...
french: À l'époque où je travaillais dans les mines, les jours de pluie étaient un vrai soulagement. Une brise fraîche circulait dans les tunnels.
russian: Когда я работал в шахтах, дождливые дни всегда приносили особое облегчение. В тоннели задувал холодный ветерок...
bulgarian: Back when I worked the Mines, rainy days were always a relief. A cool breeze would blow through the tunnels...

english: Oh, hello [Ari]! I was just pondering how to arrange the taxonomies in the insect wing.
french: Oh, bonjour [Ari] ! Je réfléchissais à l'agencement taxonomique dans l'aile dédiée aux insectes.
russian: О, привет, [Ari]! Я тут обдумываю, как организовать таксономию в секции с насекомыми.
bulgarian: Oh, hello [Ari]! I was just pondering how to arrange the taxonomies in the insect wing.

english: Much nicer to be sawing logs.
french: C'est bien plus agréable de scier du bois.
russian: Бить баклуши намного приятнее.
bulgarian: Much nicer to be sawing logs.

english: In the old days, Olric and I would already be hauling ore at this hour.
french: Autrefois, Olric et moi étions déjà en train de charger du minerai à cette heure-ci.
russian: В былое время в этот час мы с Ольриком бы таскали руду.
bulgarian: In the old days, Olric and I would already be hauling ore at this hour.

english: The stonework of the Western Ruins isn't an obvious match for any of the usual suspects... hm.
french: L'agencement des pierres dans les ruines de l'ouest ne semble correspondre à rien de ce qu'on trouve habituellement... hm.
russian: Техника каменной кладки Западных руин отличается от всех известных периодов и цивизилизаций... хм.
bulgarian: The stonework of the Western Ruins isn't an obvious match for any of the usual suspects... hm.

english: Terithia, Landen and I like to meet for dinner now and then. It's a long-standing tradition of ours.
french: Terithia, Landen et moi aimons nous retrouver pour dîner ensemble de temps à autre. C'est une habitude que nous avons prise de longue date.
russian: Мы с Теризией и Ланденом время от времени ужинаем вместе. Это у нас давняя традиция.
bulgarian: Terithia, Landen and I like to meet for dinner now and then. It's a long-standing tradition of ours.

english: Terithia brought up an artifact in her nets, something ancient... pre-Caldosian, even!
french: Terithia a remonté un artéfact dans ses filets, quelque chose d'ancien... d'avant l'époque caldosienne, même !
russian: Теризии в сеть попался артефакт. Очень древний... кажется, предкальдосийский!
bulgarian: Terithia brought up an artifact in her nets, something ancient... pre-Caldosian, even!

english: You're surely thriving here, [Ari]. Splendid!
french: Tu sembles te porter à merveille, ici, [Ari]. Fantastique !
russian: Ты здесь прямо-таки процветаешь, [Ari]. Прекрасно!
bulgarian: You're surely thriving here, [Ari]. Splendid!

english: Oh, I know that look from when I worked the Mines, [Ari]. You ought to rest.
french: Oh, je connais ce regard, je l'ai souvent vu quand je travaillais dans les mines, [Ari]. Tu dois te reposer.
russian: Ох, мне знаком такой видок ещё с работы в шахтах, [Ari]. Тебе следует отдохнуть.
bulgarian: Oh, I know that look from when I worked the Mines, [Ari]. You ought to rest.

english: Eiland spent the day investigating the Western Ruins ... he's catching me up at the inn tonight, how exciting!
french: Eiland a passé la journée à étudier les ruines de l'ouest... Il me retrouve à l'auberge ce soir, j'ai hâte !
russian: Эйланд сегодня весь день исследовал Западные руины... Сегодня вечером мы встречаемся в трактире, чтобы обсудить находки. Как волнующе!
bulgarian: Eiland spent the day investigating the Western Ruins ... he's catching me up at the inn tonight, how exciting!

english: That soup looks especially inviting today! Look at it bubble! I feel warmer just looking at it.
french: La soupe est particulièrement appétissante, aujourd'hui ! Regarde-la frémir ! Rien que la regarder me réchauffe déjà.
russian: Суп сегодня выглядит особенно аппетитно. Посмотри, как он булькает! Уже один его вид согревает.
bulgarian: That soup looks especially inviting today! Look at it bubble! I feel warmer just looking at it.

english: It makes my heart swell knowing someone will be taking care of it again.
french: J'ai le cœur gonflé de joie de savoir que quelqu'un va de nouveau s'en occuper.
russian: Радостно на сердце, что теперь кто-то о ней позаботится.
bulgarian: It makes my heart swell knowing someone will be taking care of it again.

english: Welcome once more to Mistria, [Ari].
bulgarian: Welcome once more to Mistria, [Ari].

english: That old farm has been derelict for quite some time...
french: Cette vieille ferme était à l'abandon depuis un certain temps déjà...
russian: Старая ферма уже давно была заброшена...
bulgarian: That old farm has been derelict for quite some time...

english: The people here are lovely, are they not? And now we can count you among them.
bulgarian: The people here are lovely, are they not? And now we can count you among them.

english: Salutations, [Ari]!
french: Bonjour, [Ari] ! Tu sembles bien t'acclimater.
russian: Приветствую, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Salutations, [Ari]!

english: Welcome to the Museum! Feel free to have a gander at our collection.
french: Bienvenue au musée ! Prends le temps de jeter un œil à nos collections !
russian: Добро пожаловать в музей! Не стесняйся, осмотри нашу коллекцию.
bulgarian: Welcome to the Museum! Feel free to have a gander at our collection.

english: These ruins aren't Aldarian or Caldosian... how curious.
french: Ces ruines ne sont ni aldariennes ni caldosiennes... Comme c'est étrange.
russian: Эти руины ни альдарийского ни кальдосийского происхождения... как любопытно.
bulgarian: These ruins aren't Aldarian or Caldosian... how curious.

english: To finally have confirmation that these ruins are from the age of the Witch Queens... incredible.
french: Avoir enfin la confirmation que ces ruines datent de l'époque des Reines-sorcières... c'est incroyable.
russian: Наконец-то мы получили подтверждение, что эти руины принадлежат эпохе королев-ведьм... Это невероятное чувство.
bulgarian: To finally have confirmation that these ruins are from the age of the Witch Queens... incredible.

english: Nice to see you, [Ari]! Fine day for a stroll to the Western Ruins.
french: Content de te voir, [Ari] ! Belle journée pour une balade dans les ruines de l'ouest.
russian: Рад видеть тебя, [Ari]! Хороший денёк для прогулки к Западным руинам.
bulgarian: Nice to see you, [Ari]! Fine day for a stroll to the Western Ruins.

english: Good morning! You're always working so hard, just what Mistria needs!
french: Bonjour ! Tu es toujours en train de travailler dur, c'est pile ce dont Mistria a besoin !
russian: Доброе утро! Ты всегда так усердно работаешь. Мистрии это на пользу!
bulgarian: Good morning! You're always working so hard, just what Mistria needs!

english: To think I'd still be receiving birthday presents at my age! Thank you, [Ari]. I'll treasure this.
french: Dire que je reçois encore des cadeaux d'anniversaire à mon âge ! Merci, [Ari]. Je garderai ça précieusement.
russian: Подумать только, в моём-то возрасте ещё получать подарки! Спасибо, [Ari]. Я буду это беречь...
bulgarian: To think I'd still be receiving birthday presents at my age! Thank you, [Ari]. I'll treasure this.

english: This is, ah... for me? Maybe I can find a place for it in our back catalog...
french: C'est, euh... pour moi ? Je lui trouverai peut-être une place dans notre catalogue de réserve...
russian: Это... эм... мне? Возможно, я найду для этого местечко в нашем вспомогательном каталоге...
bulgarian: This is, ah... for me? Maybe I can find a place for it in our back catalog...

english: The shiny orb of the egg... the shiny orb of my pate... I must protest at the comparison!
french: L'orbe luisant de l'œuf... l'orbe luisant de mon crâne... La comparaison m'oblige à protester !
russian: Блестящее круглое яйцо... мой блестящий лысый череп... протестую против такого сравнения!
bulgarian: The shiny orb of the egg... the shiny orb of my pate... I must protest at the comparison!

english: [Ari]... are you trying to say something with this gift of a $Boiled Egg$?
french: [Ari]... Essaierais-tu de me faire passer un message en m'offrant cet $œuf dur$ ?
russian: [Ari]... ты хочешь что-то сказать этим $варёным яйцом$?
bulgarian: [Ari]... are you trying to say something with this gift of a $Boiled Egg$?

english: Oh! This is most generous of you, [Ari]. My thanks.
french: Oh ! C'est très généreux de ta part, [Ari]. Je te remercie.
russian: О! Какой щедрый подарок, [Ari]. Благодарю.
bulgarian: Oh! This is most generous of you, [Ari]. My thanks.

english: Tremendously thoughtful of you, [Ari]. Thank you.
french: C'est extrêmement attentionné de ta part, [Ari]. Merci.
russian: Это очень внимательно с твоей стороны, [Ari]. Спасибо тебе.
bulgarian: Tremendously thoughtful of you, [Ari]. Thank you.

english: It's so kind of you to bring me a bit of refreshment. Cheers!
french: C'est si gentil de ta part de m'apporter de quoi me requinquer. Merci !
russian: Как мило с твоей стороны принести угощение. Благодарю!
bulgarian: It's so kind of you to bring me a bit of refreshment. Cheers!

english: This is just the thing to brighten the day. My thanks, [Ari].
french: C'est pile ce qu'il me fallait pour égayer ma journée. Merci, [Ari].
russian: Это, определённо, сделало мой день лучше. Спасибо, [Ari].
bulgarian: This is just the thing to brighten the day. My thanks, [Ari].

english: Why thank you very much indeed, [Ari]!.
french: Merci beaucoup, [Ari]. Vraiment !
russian: Ну что ж, огромное тебе спасибо, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Why thank you very much indeed, [Ari]!.

english: Goodness, what a considerate gift! You have my most hearty thanks.
french: Bon sang, quel cadeau plein d'attention ! Je te remercie sincèrement.
russian: Вот это да, какой заботливый подарок! Искренне благодарю.
bulgarian: Goodness, what a considerate gift! You have my most hearty thanks.

english: Oh, this is a great favorite of mine! And it looks wonderful! I can't wait to tuck into it.
french: Oh, j'adore ça ! Et ça a l'air délicieux ! J'ai hâte de me régaler.
russian: О, это одно из моих любимых блюд! И выглядит великолепно! Не терпится попробовать.
bulgarian: Oh, this is a great favorite of mine! And it looks wonderful! I can't wait to tuck into it.

english: Oho, how did you know my weakness? I must make time to properly appreciate this later.
french: Ho ho, comment sais-tu que c'est mon péché mignon ? Je dois trouver un moment tout à l'heure pour le savourer.
russian: О-хо, откуда ты знаешь о моей слабости? Надо найти время насладиться этим как следует.
bulgarian: Oho, how did you know my weakness? I must make time to properly appreciate this later.

english: My thanks, [Ari].
french: Merci, [Ari].
russian: Благодарю тебя, [Ari].
bulgarian: My thanks, [Ari].

english: Darcy's coffee is something else. I had it black my whole life, but then Darcy introduced me to the magic of a =Latte=!
french: Le café de Darcy, c'est vraiment quelque chose. Je l'avais bu noir toute ma vie, mais elle m'a fait découvrir la magie du =café latte= !
russian: Кофе Дарси — нечто особенное. Всю жизнь пил чёрный, пока Дарси не открыла мне волшебство =латте=!
bulgarian: Darcy's coffee is something else. I had it black my whole life, but then Darcy introduced me to the magic of a =Latte=!

english: Just a moment, [Ari]... looks like Darcy's got my order up!
french: Juste un instant, [Ari]... Darcy a préparé ma commande !
russian: Момент, [Ari]... кажется, Дарси несёт мой заказ!
bulgarian: Just a moment, [Ari]... looks like Darcy's got my order up!

english: Have you tried one of Darcy's =Lattes=? She does different art in the foam each time... today I received a seagull!
french: Tu as déjà goûté à l'un des =cafés latte= de Darcy ? Elle dessine chaque fois un motif différent dans la mousse... Aujourd'hui, c'était une mouette !
russian:
Ты

пробовали

пробовалапробовалпробовало =латте= от Дарси? Она каждый раз рисует на пенке что-то новое... сегодня мне досталась чайка!
bulgarian: Have you tried one of Darcy's =Lattes=? She does different art in the foam each time... today I received a seagull!

english: I don't want to influence you too much, but if you still haven't decided what to get from Darcy... I humbly recommend the =Mocha=.
french: Je ne voudrais pas trop t'influencer, mais si tu n'as pas encore choisi quoi prendre chez Darcy... je me permets de te conseiller le =mocaccino=.
russian: Не хочу сильно влиять на твой выбор, но если не можешь решить, что взять у Дарси... скромно советую =мокко=.
bulgarian: I don't want to influence you too much, but if you still haven't decided what to get from Darcy... I humbly recommend the =Mocha=.

english: Now that I'm a curator, I can wear suits every day! It's very gratifying.
french: Maintenant que je suis conservateur, je peux porter des costumes tous les jours ! C'est très gratifiant.
russian: Но теперь-то я куратор — могу каждый день ходить в костюме! Это так приятно.
bulgarian: Now that I'm a curator, I can wear suits every day! It's very gratifying.

english: Back when I worked the Mines, I couldn't wear nice clothes... I was paid well enough, but I ended up ruining whatever I wore.
french: À l'époque où j'étais mineur, je ne pouvais pas porter de beaux vêtements. Ce n'était pas une question d'argent, je finissais toujours par abîmer ce que je portais.
russian: Когда я работал в шахтах, не мог носить красивую одежду... платили-то мне неплохо, но что бы я ни надевал, всё быстро изнашивалось.
bulgarian: Back when I worked the Mines, I couldn't wear nice clothes... I was paid well enough, but I ended up ruining whatever I wore.

english: He can even fit these shoulders of mine into a tuxedo, if you can believe it.
french: Il réussit même à faire rentrer ma carrure dans un smoking, incroyable.
russian: Он даже мои плечи в смокинг втиснул, представь себе.
bulgarian: He can even fit these shoulders of mine into a tuxedo, if you can believe it.

english: I couldn't recommend Louis' bespoke suits more...
french: Je ne saurais trop recommander les costumes sur mesure de Louis...
russian: Не могу не посоветовать костюмы от Луи...
bulgarian: I couldn't recommend Louis' bespoke suits more...

english: The first thing I did after Eiland made me curator of the museum was to commission brand new clothes from Louis.
french: La première chose que j'ai faite après qu'Eiland m'a nommé conservateur du musée, ça a été de commander des habits flambant neufs chez Louis.
russian: Как только Эйланд сделал меня куратором музея, я первым делом заказал у Луи новый костюм.
bulgarian: The first thing I did after Eiland made me curator of the museum was to commission brand new clothes from Louis.

english: I like to commission a new suit from Louis once a year.
french: J'aime me commander un costume neuf chez Louis une fois par an.
russian: Я каждый год заказываю у Луи новый костюм.
bulgarian: I like to commission a new suit from Louis once a year.

english: My extra wide bedframe came from Merri's booth... my second paycheck as curator went towards it, and it's been well worth it. These shoulders need room!
french: Mon lit extralarge vient du stand de Merri... C'est là-dedans qu'est passée ma deuxième paie en tant que conservateur et ça le valait bien. Avec ma carrure, il me faut de la place !
russian: Моя широкая кровать — из лавки Мэрри... купил на вторую зарплату куратора. Оно того стоило. Плечам нужно место!
bulgarian: My extra wide bedframe came from Merri's booth... my second paycheck as curator went towards it, and it's been well worth it. These shoulders need room!

english: I use an old miner's crate to store odds and ends, and Merri was kind enough to restore and finish it. I never thought of it as furniture, but it's a nice memento now.
french: Je rangeais mon bazar dans une vieille caisse de mineur et Merri me l'a gentiment restaurée et patinée. Ce n'est pas un meuble, pour moi, mais c'est maintenant un joli souvenir.
russian: Я храню всякую мелочь в старом шахтёрском ящике; Мэрри благородно его отреставрировала. Раньше я как-то не считал его мебелью, а теперь он хранит память.
bulgarian: I use an old miner's crate to store odds and ends, and Merri was kind enough to restore and finish it. I never thought of it as furniture, but it's a nice memento now.

english: Landen's got too much pride to buy furniture from Merri's, but I've seen him eyeing a new dresser every now and again. At least Ryis got that bookshelf they have upstairs.
french: Landen est trop fier pour acheter chez Merri, mais je l'ai déjà vu s'intéresser à une nouvelle commode, à l'occasion. Ryis a au moins acheté la bibliothèque qu'ils ont à l'étage.
russian: Ланден слишком горд, чтобы покупать мебель у Мэрри, но я видел, как он заглядывался на комод. Ну, хотя бы Риз купил у неё новую книжную полку на второй этаж.
bulgarian: Landen's got too much pride to buy furniture from Merri's, but I've seen him eyeing a new dresser every now and again. At least Ryis got that bookshelf they have upstairs.

english: Josephine must singlehandedly keep Merri in business... the Inn must be at least half furnished with Merri's restorations.
french: À elle seule, Joséphine doit faire tourner les affaires de Merri... Au moins la moitié de l'auberge est meublée d'antiquités restaurées.
russian: Джозефина и одна может обеспечить Мэрри поток заказов... полгостиницы обставлено мебелью, которую Мэрри отреставрировала.
bulgarian: Josephine must singlehandedly keep Merri in business... the Inn must be at least half furnished with Merri's restorations.

english: Stillwell told me that great discoveries await, and then I found my missing keys in my other pocket... this young man holds great power.
bulgarian: Stillwell told me that great discoveries await, and then I found my missing keys in my other pocket... this young man holds great power.

english: You're never too old to get a love fortune! Whether or not you can understand Stillwell's cryptic blubbering is another question, though...
bulgarian: You're never too old to get a love fortune! Whether or not you can understand Stillwell's cryptic blubbering is another question, though...

english: Stillwell told me that my greatest days lie yet ahead... that swells my heart, [Ari]. I never even dreamed of becoming a curator, so to think there's more... I can't wait!
bulgarian: Stillwell told me that my greatest days lie yet ahead... that swells my heart, [Ari]. I never even dreamed of becoming a curator, so to think there's more... I can't wait!

english: There are ancient tales of seers in old texts of empires past, but I wasn't a believer until I met Stillwell.
bulgarian: There are ancient tales of seers in old texts of empires past, but I wasn't a believer until I met Stillwell.

english: It's never too late for one to expand their horizons!
french: Comme quoi, il n'est jamais trop tard pour élargir son horizon !
russian: Но никогда не поздно расширять кругозор!
bulgarian: It's never too late for one to expand their horizons!

english: This $Cooking Challenge$ of Taliferro's has inspired me! I never had much time for more than the quick recipes when I worked the Mines.
french: Le $défi gastronomique$ de Taliferro m'a donné envie ! Quand je travaillais à la mine, je n'avais le temps que pour des recettes rapides à préparer.
russian: Эти $смотры блюд$ Талиферро меня вдохновили! Когда я работал в шахтах, у меня не было времени на что-то сложнее быстрых блюд.
bulgarian: This $Cooking Challenge$ of Taliferro's has inspired me! I never had much time for more than the quick recipes when I worked the Mines.

english: It is obvious that, as the judge of a $Cooking Challenge$, Taliferro must have a critical eye...
french: En tant que juré d'un $défi gastronomique$, Taliferro se doit d'avoir un regard critique...
russian: Очевидно, что Талиферро как арбитр $смотра блюд$ должен сохранять критический взгляд...
bulgarian: It is obvious that, as the judge of a $Cooking Challenge$, Taliferro must have a critical eye...

english: But does he perhaps have too critical of a mouth?
french: Mais n'aurait-il pas la critique facile en général ?
russian: Но не слишком ли критический у него язык?
bulgarian: But does he perhaps have too critical of a mouth?

english: Ah, a moment of your time, [Ari].
french: Ah, peux-tu me consacrer quelques instants, [Ari] ?
russian: А, [Ari], можно тебя на минутку?
bulgarian: Ah, a moment of your time, [Ari].

english: Perhaps he faced hardships that changed him in ways that are difficult for outsiders to understand.
french: Il a peut-être enduré des épreuves qui l'ont changé d'une manière que nous autres ne pouvons pas comprendre.
russian: Возможно, какие-то прожитые трудности сделали из него человека, которого сложно понять.
bulgarian: Perhaps he faced hardships that changed him in ways that are difficult for outsiders to understand.

english: Or... he's simply a very rude man. It's one or the other, I tell you!
french: Ou c'est tout simplement un malotru. Ça ne peut être que l'un ou l'autre !
russian: Либо... он отвратительный грубиян. Тут уж одно из двух, я тебе скажу!
bulgarian: Or... he's simply a very rude man. It's one or the other, I tell you!

english: Based on the way Taliferro speaks to the contestants here, I can only surmise that the cooking world is quite harsh in the Capital.
french: Quand je vois la façon dont Taliferro s'adresse aux concurrents, j'imagine que le monde de la cuisine doit être impitoyable à la capitale.
russian: Судя по тому, как Талиферро разговаривает с местными участниками, могу лишь предполагать, как жесток мир кулинарии в столице.
bulgarian: Based on the way Taliferro speaks to the contestants here, I can only surmise that the cooking world is quite harsh in the Capital.

english: I am a gentle soul, and so...
french: Je suis foncièrement bon, alors...
russian: У меня ранимая душа, так что...
bulgarian: I am a gentle soul, and so...

english: I am a gentle soul, and so I have chosen not to take Taliferro's criticisms to heart.
french: Dans ma grande bienveillance, j'ai décidé de ne pas prendre les critiques de Taliferro à cœur.
russian: У меня ранимая душа, так что я решил не принимать критику Талиферро близко к сердцу.
bulgarian: I am a gentle soul, and so I have chosen not to take Taliferro's criticisms to heart.

english: I like to have Vera clean up my beard, whenever I have the opportunity... I can do it myself, but she always does it better.
french: J'aime que Vera me taille la barbe, à l'occasion... Je peux le faire moi-même, mais elle s'en sort bien mieux.
russian: Я люблю обращаться к Вере, чтобы она подровняла мою бороду... Я и сам могу, но она делает лучше.
bulgarian: I like to have Vera clean up my beard, whenever I have the opportunity... I can do it myself, but she always does it better.

english: Vera offered to dye my beard, but I like the white! It makes me look distinguished, don't you think?
french: Vera m'a proposé de me teindre la barbe, mais j'aime qu'elle soit blanche ! Cela me donne un air distingué, tu ne trouves pas ?
russian: Вера предлагала покрасить бороду, но мне нравится седина! Солидно же выглядит, правда?
bulgarian: Vera offered to dye my beard, but I like the white! It makes me look distinguished, don't you think?

english: I don't get to chat with Vera much because my visits with her are usually pretty quick, hoho!
french: Je ne discute pas beaucoup avec Vera, parce que mes passages chez elle sont généralement assez rapides, ho ho !
russian: Мы с Верой почти не болтаем, потому что она всё время очень быстро заканчивает стрижку, хо-хо!
bulgarian: I don't get to chat with Vera much because my visits with her are usually pretty quick, hoho!

english: I suppose dyeing one's hair must be a fun change of pace... hmm.
french: J'imagine que se teindre les cheveux représente un drôle de changement... Mmm.
russian: Наверное, красить волосы — забавно для разнообразия... хм.
bulgarian: I suppose dyeing one's hair must be a fun change of pace... hmm.

english: He sold me a 'make your own artifact' kit for a big pile of tesserae. Then he handed a single coin back, and told me to hold onto it for two hundred years!
french: Je lui ai donné un beau paquet de tesserae pour un soi-disant kit de fabrication d'artéfacts. Là-dessus, il m'a simplement donné une simple pièce en me disant de la conserver deux cents ans !
russian: Он продал мне набор «сделай свой артефакт» за кучу тессер. А затем выдал одну-единственную монетку и сказал хранить двести лет!
bulgarian: He sold me a 'make your own artifact' kit for a big pile of tesserae. Then he handed a single coin back, and told me to hold onto it for two hundred years!

english: Anything becomes an artifact if you wait long enough! Pah!
french: N'importe quoi est artéfact si on attend assez longtemps ! Pfff !
russian: Любая вещь станет артефактом, если подождать подольше! Пф!
bulgarian: Anything becomes an artifact if you wait long enough! Pah!

english: Keep an eye on that Wheedle fellow, [Ari]. He's not to be trusted!
french: Garde un œil sur ce Wheedle, [Ari]. Il ne faut pas lui faire confiance !
russian: Не спускай с этого Хлюста глаз, [Ari]. Ему нельзя доверять.
bulgarian: Keep an eye on that Wheedle fellow, [Ari]. He's not to be trusted!

english: There's formal, there's country aristocratic, there's dandy, and then there's... whatever Wheedle's doing.
french: Mais il existe des tenues de cérémonie, des tenues pour noble de campagne. On a aussi la tenue dandy chic et puis... ce que porte Wheedle.
russian: Костюм бывает формальный, бывает загородный артистократический, бывает щегольской, а бывает... какая-то ерунда, как у Хлюста.
bulgarian: There's formal, there's country aristocratic, there's dandy, and then there's... whatever Wheedle's doing.

english: It may surprise you that I have some opinions about suits, [Ari].
french: Ça va peut-être te surprendre que je parle vêtements, [Ari].
russian: Возможно, тебя это удивит, [Ari], но у меня есть своё мнение о костюме.
bulgarian: It may surprise you that I have some opinions about suits, [Ari].

english: They tore it up after his road rations caused a very unfortunate episode that went down in infamy as... The Very Unfortunate Episode.
french: La guilde l'aurait résilié parce que ses rations de voyage auraient été à l'origine d'une mésaventure peu agréable encore dans toutes les mémoires.
russian: Они её расторгли, когда из-за его походных припасов произошло крайне неприятное событие, которое вошло в историю как... Крайне Неприятное Событие.
bulgarian: They tore it up after his road rations caused a very unfortunate episode that went down in infamy as... The Very Unfortunate Episode.

english: Rumor has it that Wheedle tried to ink an exclusive deal with the Adventurer's Guild in the Capital.
french: Il paraît que Wheedle avait négocié un contrat exclusif d'approvisionnement avec la guilde des aventuriers de la capitale.
russian: Говорят, Хлюст почти подписал со столичной гильдией приключенцев эксклюзивную сделку.
bulgarian: Rumor has it that Wheedle tried to ink an exclusive deal with the Adventurer's Guild in the Capital.

english: And then I'm disappointed whenever it comes out that he simply rolled some common pottery around in the dirt.
french: Et puis, je suis déçu quand je me rends compte que c'est juste un vase ordinaire qu'il a recouvert de terre et de poussière.
russian: А потом разочарование, когда выясняется, что он обвалял в грязи очередной простой горшок.
bulgarian: And then I'm disappointed whenever it comes out that he simply rolled some common pottery around in the dirt.

english: I get excited every time Wheedle tells me he's found some ancient artifact...
french: Je m'emballe chaque fois que Wheedle me dit qu'il a trouvé un artéfact...
russian: Каждый раз, когда Хлюст говорит, что нашёл древний артефакт, меня охватывает любопытство...
bulgarian: I get excited every time Wheedle tells me he's found some ancient artifact...

english: I sang her a few, but many of them are too base to sing aloud on a Market Day!
french: Je lui en ai chanté quelques-uns, mais pour la plupart, la tonalité est trop basse pour qu'elles soient chantées sur le marché du samedi !
russian: Я ей парочку спел, но чаще всего они такие грубые, что стыдно петь вслух в базарный день!
bulgarian: I sang her a few, but many of them are too base to sing aloud on a Market Day!

english: That Zorel wanted to know if I knew any traditional Miner songs.
french: Zorel voulait savoir si je connaissais quelques chants de mineurs traditionnels.
russian: Зорель расспрашивала меня, не знаю ли я традиционных шахтёрских песен.
bulgarian: That Zorel wanted to know if I knew any traditional Miner songs.

english: She had a number of heated remarks for that fish's behavior!
french: Elle a fait un certain nombre de réflexions bien senties sur le comportement de ce poisson !
russian: Она озвучила немало острых замечаний насчёт поведения этой рыбы!
bulgarian: She had a number of heated remarks for that fish's behavior!

english: Terithia was most incensed when she found out that we now have a $Bait Thief$ on display at the Museum.
french: Terithia était vraiment furieuse quand elle a découvert que nous avions maintenant un $poisson malandrin$ exposé au musée.
russian: Теризия пришла в ярость, когда обнаружила, что у нас в музее выставляется $похититель наживки$.
bulgarian: Terithia was most incensed when she found out that we now have a $Bait Thief$ on display at the Museum.

english: It's also quite wrong. All it's good for is getting someone lost.
french: Elle est aussi complètement fausse. Elle ne servirait qu'à perdre les gens.
russian: А ещё она действительно абсолютно неверная. С ней только заблудиться.
bulgarian: It's also quite wrong. All it's good for is getting someone lost.

english: Thank you for donating the, er, $Completely Wrong Map$. It's very well preserved.
french: Merci d'avoir fait don de, euh, cette $carte erronée$. Elle est très bien conservée.
russian: Спасибо за твое пожертвование в виде, эм, $совершенно неверной карты$. Она в отличном состоянии.
bulgarian: Thank you for donating the, er, $Completely Wrong Map$. It's very well preserved.

english: We did turn these up from time to time when I worked the Mines, but this is by far the most intact I've ever seen. Good eye.
french: Nous en trouvions de temps en temps à l'époque où je travaillais dans les mines, mais celle-ci est de loin la mieux conservée que j'aie vue. Tu as l'œil.
russian: Мы уже находили такие, когда я работал в шахтах. Но этот экземпляр пока наиболее хорошо сохранившийся. У тебя глаз намётан.
bulgarian: We did turn these up from time to time when I worked the Mines, but this is by far the most intact I've ever seen. Good eye.

english: I was inspecting that $Flint Arrowhead$ you so generously donated, [Ari].
french: J'ai étudié la $pointe de flèche en silex$ dont tu nous as si généreusement fait cadeau, [Ari].
russian:
Я тут осматривал $кремнёвый наконечник$, который ты

пожертвовали

пожертвовалапожертвовалпожертвовало, [Ari].
bulgarian: I was inspecting that $Flint Arrowhead$ you so generously donated, [Ari].

english: Nothing's quite as welcome as a single fluttering moth leading you back to light.
french: On accueille avec une grande reconnaissance une seule phalène papillonnante capable de nous ramener vers la lumière.
russian: Наткнуться на одинокую порхающую моль, указывающую путь к свету, — будет несравнимой удачей.
bulgarian: Nothing's quite as welcome as a single fluttering moth leading you back to light.

english: I felt such an unexpected fondness when you donated the $Lantern Moth$ you found in the Mines. They look quite humble, but if you were ever lost in the dark, well...
french: J'ai éprouvé une émotion inattendue quand tu as fait don de la $phalène luminophile$ trouvée dans les mines. Elles n'ont l'air de rien, mais quand on est perdu dans le noir, eh bien...
russian:
Я почувствовал неожиданный прилив любви, когда ты

пожертвовали

пожертвовалапожертвовалты пожертвовало $лампадника$ из шахт. Он выглядит скромно, но если вдруг потеряться в темноте, то...
bulgarian: I felt such an unexpected fondness when you donated the $Lantern Moth$ you found in the Mines. They look quite humble, but if you were ever lost in the dark, well...

english: Oh yes! I did manage to inspect the message inside.
french: Oh, oui ! J'ai réussi à lire le message, à l'intérieur.
russian: Ах, да! У меня получилось рассмотреть само послание.
bulgarian: Oh yes! I did manage to inspect the message inside.

english: It was from some far flung island I'd never heard of before.
french: Il provenait d'une île lointaine dont je n'avais jamais entendu parler auparavant.
russian: Оно пришло с какого-то далёкого острова. Я про него даже не слышал.
bulgarian: It was from some far flung island I'd never heard of before.

english: Their high priest was looking for a pen pal! I was happy to oblige him.
french: Leur grand prêtre cherchait un correspondant ! J'ai été ravi de lui répondre.
russian: Тамошний верховный жрец ищет друга по переписке! Я с удовольствием написал ему ответ.
bulgarian: Their high priest was looking for a pen pal! I was happy to oblige him.

english: The $Message in a Bottle$ you donated...?
french: Le $message dans une bouteille$ dont tu as fait don...?
russian:
Ты насчёт $Записки в бутылке$, которую ты

пожертвовали

пожертвовалапожертвовалпожертвовало?..
bulgarian: The $Message in a Bottle$ you donated...?

english: However, Eiland adding my old =Miner's Helmet= to the collection is a bit much!
french: Cependant, je trouve un peu excessif qu'Eiland ajoute mon vieux =casque de mineur= à nos collections !
russian: Но решение Эйланда добавить в коллекцию мою старую =шахтёрскую каску= — это уже перебор!
bulgarian: However, Eiland adding my old =Miner's Helmet= to the collection is a bit much!

english: I want you to know that I always appreciate your donations to the Museum, [Ari].
french: J'aimerais que tu saches combien j'apprécie tes dons au musée, [Ari].
russian: Знай: я всегда ценю твои пожертвования в музей, [Ari].
bulgarian: I want you to know that I always appreciate your donations to the Museum, [Ari].

english: I don't quite have the heart to tell him it's one of Olric's. He'd forget a pickaxe down there quite regularly...
french: Je n'ai pas le cœur à lui dire qu'elle appartient à Olric, en fait. Il lui arrive régulièrement d'oublier une de ses pioches là en bas...
russian: Мне как-то даже неловко говорить ему, что это кирка Ольрика. Он частенько их там внизу забывал...
bulgarian: I don't quite have the heart to tell him it's one of Olric's. He'd forget a pickaxe down there quite regularly...

english: Lord Eiland was quite thrilled when you brought that $Miner's Pickaxe$ to the Museum. "A tool from a bygone era!", he said.
french: Messire Eiland était vraiment ravi quand tu as apporté cette $pioche de mineur$ au musée. « Un outil d'une ère révolue ! », a-t-il dit.
russian:
Лорд Эйланд был в таком восторге, когда ты

принесли

принеслапринёспринесло в музей $шахтёрскую кирку$. Он сказал: «Это инструмент ушедшей эпохи!»
bulgarian: Lord Eiland was quite thrilled when you brought that $Miner's Pickaxe$ to the Museum. "A tool from a bygone era!", he said.

english: The $Miner's Rucksack$ you brought in piqued my interest! That style of bag was from the time of my father's father. You can tell by the way it's been dyed.
french: Le $sac à dos de mineur$ que tu as apporté a piqué ma curiosité ! Ce style de sac remonte à l'époque du père de mon père. Ça se voit à la façon dont il est teint.
russian:
Меня очень заинтересовал $шахтёрский рюкзак$, который ты

нашли

нашланашёлнашло! Такой тип сумки был ещё во времена моего деда. Видно по краске.
bulgarian: The $Miner's Rucksack$ you brought in piqued my interest! That style of bag was from the time of my father's father. You can tell by the way it's been dyed.

english: I suppose the Museum's not a bad place for them!
french: J'imagine qu'elles ne seront pas mal, au musée !
russian: Полагаю, музей не худшее место для них!
bulgarian: I suppose the Museum's not a bad place for them!

english: It had been a while since I'd seen one of those $Miner's Slabs$. We used them to navigate the Mines safely, but they're sadly all out of date since the earthquake.
french: Cela faisait belle lurette que je n'avais pas vu une de ces $plaques de mineur$. On les utilisait pour se repérer dans les mines, mais depuis le tremblement de terre, elles ne sont malheureusement plus à jour.
russian: Прошло много лет с тех пор, как я видел одну из этих $шахтёрских плиток$. Мы использовали их, чтобы ориентироваться в шахтах, но после землетрясения они, увы, устарели.
bulgarian: It had been a while since I'd seen one of those $Miner's Slabs$. We used them to navigate the Mines safely, but they're sadly all out of date since the earthquake.

english: That $Parchment Moth$ in the collection strikes fear in me! Can you imagine if one got loose in the archive? It would be a disaster!
french: La $mite des parchemins$ qui figure dans nos collections me fait peur ! Imagine si l'une d'elles était lâchée dans les archives... Ce serait un désastre !
russian: Однако $пергаментная моль$ в нашей коллекции меня пугает! Представляешь, что случится, если она ненароком попадёт в архивы? Это же будет просто катастрофа!
bulgarian: That $Parchment Moth$ in the collection strikes fear in me! Can you imagine if one got loose in the archive? It would be a disaster!

english: While I am one hundred percent behind Lord Eiland in his efforts at preservation and conservation...
french: Bien que je soutienne pleinement messire Eiland dans ses efforts de protection et de conservation...
russian: Я всецело поддерживаю старания лорда Эйланда по сохранению видов...
bulgarian: While I am one hundred percent behind Lord Eiland in his efforts at preservation and conservation...

english: $Peat$ is a great fuel source for your crafting endeavors, [Ari]. It smells wonderful as well!
french: La $tourbe$ est une excellente source d'énergie si tu souhaites fabriquer des choses, [Ari]. Et puis elle sent merveilleusement bon !
russian: $Торф$ — отличное топливо, [Ari]. Пригодится в ремесле, да и пахнет просто замечательно!
bulgarian: $Peat$ is a great fuel source for your crafting endeavors, [Ari]. It smells wonderful as well!
